lines: UNIT
INTRODUCTION
TO BIOLOGY
After studying thisunit, thestudents will be ableto
Define biology,its major divisions i.e.Botany,Zoologyand Microbiology.
Define the branches of Biology.
Link the study of biology with that of Physics, Chermistry, Mathernatics,
Geographyand Economics,
Explainhowthestudyofbiologycanleadtodifferentcareers,
Identify that living organisms are divided into five groups i.e. prokaryotes,
protists, fungi, plants and animals.
Relate at least three verses from the Holy Quran, instructing for the study of
the origin and the characteristics of life, with the modern scientific
achievements.
Relate the contributions of Jaber Bin Hayan, Abdul Malik Asmaiand Bu Ali Sina
with the currentknowledgeabout plants andanimals.
Describe bioelements as the most basic levelof biologicalorganization.
Define biomolecules and distinguish them as micromolecules and
macromolecules.
Describe the level of organization of life (organelles, cells, tissues, organs,
organ systems and individuals).
Explain division oflaboramougcells and tissues ina multicellularorganism.
Compare cellular organization in organisms i.e. unicellular organization
(Amoeba), colonial organization (Volvox) and multicellular organization
(mustard and frog). (Only brief comparison referring to cellular organization is
required. Details of organs and organ-systems of frog and mustard should be
avoided).
